messages.content: Extract explicit persistent post-unit state only. Never infer a state from activity. Return JSON only.

message.reasoning:
We need to extract explicit persistent post-unit facts from the source unit: "Amy lets Will and Amber out of the basement."

So Amy is letting Will and Amber out of the basement. The action: "out of" but no destination named. So set_location only when SOURCE UNIT explicitly puts an entity at/in/to a named destination. Here it's just out of X, not specifying where they go to. So we don't set location.

Set_containment? It says if source unit explicitly puts an entity into/inside a named container or enclosed place (contained), or explicitly lets/removes it out of that named container/place (free). The basement is the container/enclosed place. Amy lets Will and Amber out of the basement, so they are removed from the basement: free.

Thus we need set_containment for each entity: Will and Amber with container "basement" value "free".

Also maybe set_location? Not because no destination named.

Set_item_state etc not relevant.

So output should be:

{
  "state_effects": [
    {"op":"set_containment","entity":"Will","container":"basement","value":"free"},
    {"op":"set_containment","entity":"Amber","container":"basement","value":"free"}
  ]
}

Check if any other rule: set_location only when explicitly puts an entity at/in/to a named destination. Not here.

Thus final JSON.
